title: Setting a reorder point
caption: Order when stock falls to the demand expected during the supplier's lead time plus a safety stock for variation: 200 + 60 = 260 units.
alt: One stacked column of 260 units: 200 units of lead-time demand and 60 units of safety stock.
description: Sales average 40 units a day and the lead time is 5 days.
Demand during the lead time is 40 × 5 = 200 units.
